In Episode 29 of The Corruption Chronicles, I'm breaking down the latest questions surrounding Doug Burgum's investments and the Trump Administration's plans for our public lands.
 
Trump's Interior Secretary, Doug Burgum, has as much as $64 MILLION invested in AI companies while helping open up our public lands to massive AI data centers.
 
The very person helping decide whether these companies can build on federal land has a significant financial stake in the industry that stands to benefit.
 
The Interior Department insists Burgum has complied with federal ethics rules. But that doesn't make the potential conflict of interest any less concerning.
 
The American people deserve to know that decisions about our public lands are being made in THEIR best interests, not those of government officials and their investment portfolios.
 
Come January, Congress must investigate conflicts of interest like this and demand accountability.
